_comment: Deep Time's vanilla essentials (plan §7.8): the deposit stage keeps at least min_sites_per_region sites of the material in every land region of region_blocks. Zinc's producers (MVT, SEDEX, impact hydrothermal) are as rare as copper's, so it takes copper's region (ledger ORE-273). Skipped without a #c:ores/zinc block (Create). Initial values; packs ship their own list (decisions file, "Playability overrides").
